label: Q01
loop: pick a mystery box -> assemble and customize slime food at your table -> film/squish creations to earn coins and subs -> buy new boxes when shops restock
objectives: make and film slime-food creations to grow coins and subscribers
progression: coins, subscriber count, new box types and extras
instructions: pick a box, open it, customize slime food with extras, film it to earn coins and subs; visit friends to collab
unique: ASMR slime-food making framed as a content-creator job
thumbnails: avatar stretching gooey slime waffles, donuts and fried chicken on a picnic table
complexity_notes: table/box UI, stretchy food meshes, simple customization; small map

label: Q02
loop: open ability packs -> equip superpower cards -> fight zones and bosses -> place cards on base holders for cash/sec -> upgrade and unlock next zone
objectives: pull rare power cards and defeat the final Dominus boss
progression: card rarities and levels, zones unlocked by bosses, power/health upgrades, index completion
instructions: open packs, fight through zones, defeat bosses, place cards on base to earn cash, complete the index
unique: steal-a-x title wrapped around card-pack superpower combat with idle base income
thumbnails: mystery glowing cards held by heroes, lightning-charged characters, flaming fist
complexity_notes: multiple zones, ability VFX sets, boss AI, base income system

label: Q03
loop: spawn as baby animal -> find food and water -> grow to adult/elder -> hunt or flee other players -> unlock more species
objectives: survive and grow your animal in a predator/prey valley
progression: growth stages, amber currency, new species and slots
instructions: be born as a wolf or deer, find food and water, grow to adulthood; hunter or prey
unique: realistic-looking animal survival (Creatures-of-Sonaria-like) with naturalistic visuals
thumbnails: realistic tiger, crocodile, elk and cougars fighting in a valley; cartoon hippo icon
complexity_notes: realistic animal rigs and animations, open terrain map, survival stats

label: Q04
loop: acquire a symbiote -> toggle suit -> web-swing around the city -> buy shards/customizations
objectives: get a symbiote and become the strongest
instructions: acquire a symbiote, press Q to toggle suit, F to swing
thumbnails: a muscular Venom character with title text
complexity_notes: suit swap and swinging; little described content

objectives: grow a little shop into a phone case empire

thumbnails: first-person hands painting glittery phone cases on a desk

label: Q06

instructions: start as a student and find out what power you get
